cell.name: E. coli
cell.note: Facultative heterotroph. Ferments to acetate, formate and ethanol when O2 runs short.

reactions.name: NADH dehydrogenase (pumps H+ into the periplasm)

PDH.equation: coa_c + nad_c + pyr_c --> accoa_c + co2_c + nadh_c

CS.equation: accoa_c + h2o_c + oaa_c --> cit_c + coa_c + h_c

AKGDH.equation: akg_c + coa_c + nad_c --> co2_c + nadh_c + succoa_c

SUCOAS.equation: atp_c + coa_c + succ_c <=> adp_c + pi_c + succoa_c

PPC.equation: co2_c + h2o_c + pep_c --> h_c + oaa_c + pi_c

PPS.equation: atp_c + h2o_c + pyr_c --> amp_c + 2 h_c + pep_c + pi_c

MALS.equation: accoa_c + glx_c + h2o_c --> coa_c + h_c + mal__L_c

ACALD.equation: acald_c + coa_c + nad_c <=> accoa_c + h_c + nadh_c

NADH16pp.equation: 4 h_c + nadh_c + q8_c --> 3 h_p + nad_c + q8h2_c

ATPS4rpp.equation: adp_c + 4 h_p + pi_c <=> atp_c + h2o_c + 3 h_c

THD2pp.equation: 2 h_p + nadh_c + nadp_c --> 2 h_c + nad_c + nadph_c

GLUDy.equation: glu__L_c + h2o_c + nadp_c <=> akg_c + h_c + nadph_c + nh4_c

GLNS.equation: atp_c + glu__L_c + nh4_c --> adp_c + gln__L_c + h_c + pi_c
